_comment: Example portfolio file for upkeep-mcp. Copy it to sites.json and edit.
sites.json and sites.local.json are gitignored — your real client list never gets committed.
So is upkeep-history.json, the history file named below: it records which of your sites
were at which severity, so it names your clients just as this file does. Point `history`
somewhere else and you must add that name to .gitignore yourself.
Top level:
version            Format version. Currently 1.
history            Optional, and absent here on purpose: add the line yourself and
this server starts writing a file, leave it out and it never does.
Add it as   "history": "upkeep-history.json",   next to "version".
It is where the previous run is kept, so
`portfolio_report` can say what changed even after this server
restarts. Relative paths are resolved next to THIS file, not
against the working directory. Omit it and nothing is written:
the comparison lives in memory and is lost on restart.
The file records one snapshot — which sites were at which
severity, and the finding codes — so it names your clients. It
is created readable by you alone (0600), replaced on every run,
and ignored once it is more than 90 days old. It is written and
read by this server; do not edit it by hand. The name used here
is in .gitignore; any other name is yours to add.
defaults           Applied to every site; each site may override any of these.
sites              The portfolio. Every entry needs at least `name` and `url`.
Per site:
name               Human label used in reports. Free text.
url                Full URL including scheme, the address a visitor would use.
domain             Registrable domain for registration and DNS checks.
Optional — derived from `url` when omitted. Set it when the
site lives on a subdomain and you want the parent checked.
checks             Which checks to run. Omit to use defaults.checks.
maxLinks           Internal links the seo check may request, 0 to check none.
Defaults to 25. This is what a portfolio run spends its time
on: one request per link, paced at half a second per host, so
25 links is about twelve seconds for that site. Measured: a
portfolio of twenty takes eight seconds without seo and about
a minute with it.
expiryWarningDays  Warn this many days before the registration expires.
Certificates keep their own, shorter window (14 days), because
ACME clients renew with 30 days left and warning earlier would
fire on every healthy site. A value below 14 applies to both.
tags               Free-form labels for filtering a report.
notes              Context for you; carried through into the report output.
Valid check names: domain, ssl, uptime, seo, accessibility.
accessibility needs a browser: run `npx playwright install chromium` once, or the
check reports as unknown for that site rather than as a pass it did not earn.

sites.name: Example Bakery
sites.notes: Smallest possible entry: everything else comes from defaults.

sites.name: Example Foundation
sites.notes: Renewal is slow to approve, so warn earlier than the default.

sites.name: Example Foundation — Shop
sites.notes: Runs on a subdomain; `domain` points registration checks at the apex.

sites.name: Example Net (legacy)
sites.notes: Still on http://. uptime_check reports the missing redirect to https.
